description: Lure words of brand-abuse domains (P028 cond 8, PT and EN): CR35 new_brand_keyword_domain fires on a domain at most 30 days old whose name combines an org_profile brand keyword with one of these words. Matching happens after IDNA->Unicode, accent and homoglyph folding (v3lum.correlations.typosquat.fold_text); words of 5+ letters also match inside a label, shorter ones only as a whole hyphen/underscore token. The P376 hostile-host guard (v3lum.core.policy.lure_words) reads the same list. Editable: keep words lower-case ASCII with accents folded (seguranca, not seguranca with a cedilla) and keep 'words' equal to 'pt' plus 'en' (tests/test_pack_typosquat.py checks it).
licence: Own work of the V3LUM team (proprietary-internal, A6): the P028 cond 8 list plus direct inflections and English equivalents; no third-party word list was copied.
source: P028 final condition 8 (Council #1): conta, pix, boleto, sac, segunda-via/2via, fatura, cartao, credito, emprestimo, fgts, inss, gov, receita, regularizar, desbloqueio, premio, cashback, pontos, login, seguranca, atualizacao, token
notes: Shared core list (P028 cond 8 names data/brand_lures_pt.json). The P012 typosquat module keeps its larger ranking dictionary under v3lum/data/typosquat/; this file is the short, high-signal list correlations and the egress guard use.
